title: The canonical sheet-sum normalization of an internal trace
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, $p:U\to X$ a scheme morphism and $P$ an internal $\Lambda_X$-module [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], with the coefficient pullbacks, direct images and adjunction of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. For $\tau:p_*p^*P\to P$, define its sheet-sum condition as follows. For every weakly etale $g:Y\to X$, finite list $t_j:Y\to U$ with $t_jp=g$ whose induced maps $Y\to U\times_XY$ form a coproduct decomposition, $g^*\tau$ equals the sum of the canonical sheet projections. The $j$th projection is $g^*p_*p^*P\cong t_j^*p^*p_*p^*P\to t_j^*p^*P\cong g^*P$, with middle arrow the pullback of the actual counit at $p^*P$ and outer arrows the composition comparisons of [def-sfb-module-upper-star-comp]. Empty lists give the zero sum. This is a predicate on an actual morphism, not a choice of trace.
